desc.zh_HK: 一張尾班車票根，邊角起晒毛。
desc.zh_CN: 一张末班车的票根，边角起了毛。
desc.en: A last-tram ticket stub, furred at the edges.

use_locked.zh_HK: 呢張票根而家幫唔到手。
use_locked.zh_CN: 这张票根现在帮不上手。
use_locked.en: The ticket stub can't help right now.

text.zh_HK: 票根一捏，頭頂傳來引擎聲。
text.zh_CN: 票根一捏，头顶传来引擎声。
text.en: The stub crinkles, and an engine roars somewhere overhead.

_comment: The chapter-4 door: usable once ch03 is complete (a last-tram stub opens the generation that moved up).
